Package index

All functions

RiboPilot()
Open the RiboPilot GUI
annotate_project()
Annotate assembled samples for a project
annotate_seq()
Annotate the nuclear rDNA feature model on a single sequence (all in R)
apply_project_taxonomy()
Freeze confirmed taxids + lineages from the review CSV into `samples`
assign_export_group()
Assign selected samples to an export group
build_reference_db()
Build a clade nuclear-rDNA reference database (GetOrganelle seeds + labels)
clear_export_group()
Clear the export group of selected samples
compute_ref_alignment()
Compute per-feature sample-vs-reference alignments for one sample
curate_actinopterygii_rrna()
Thin actinopterygii curation wrapper.
curate_one()
Curate one sample's annotations and write results back to the DB
curate_rrna_core()
Curate one reconciled nrDNA feature model against a clade ruleset (pure)
ensure_curate_schema()
Ensure the curation columns/tables exist (idempotent)
ensure_taxdump()
Download a pinned NCBI taxdump tarball into `dir` (once per project)
export_bundle()
Build a GenBank submission bundle for a set of samples (one export group)
export_project()
Export every assigned export group in a project
extract_rdna_contigs()
Keep the rDNA contigs (BLAST hit vs the label DB) and write assembly fastas
fallback_assemble_one()
Run an assembly fallback for one sample (Option B2 baiting, or Option A)
generate_config()
Generate and save a reusable cluster config profile
list_configs()
List available executor configs
load_assemblies()
Load one sample's published assembly fastas into the database
migrate_db()
Bring a project database up to the current schema (idempotent, additive)
migrate_project()
Migrate the project database at a path to the current schema
new_db()
Initialize a new RiboPilot project database
new_project()
Initialize a new RiboPilot project
new_test_project()
Initialize a RiboPilot test project
open_project_db()
Open a project DB connection with WAL + busy timeout (safe for concurrent writes from parallel Nextflow processes)
parse_blast_candidates()
Parse remote blastn hits into ranked reference candidates
parse_feature_table()
Parse an NCBI feature table (efetch -format ft) into rRNA/ITS features
reconcile_one()
Reconcile barrnap + ITSx outputs for one sample; write annotations
resolve_project_taxonomy()
Resolve all sample Taxon strings and write a review table for confirmation
resolve_taxonomy()
Resolve sample Taxon strings to NCBI taxids + lineages (for confirmation)
ribopilot_config_dir()
RiboPilot user config directory
ribopilot_ref_dir()
Default directory for user-built reference databases
run_annotate()
Run the annotation workflow (WF2) for a project
run_app()
Run the RiboPilot Shiny application
run_assembly()
Run the assembly workflow (WF1) for a project
run_fallback()
Run an assembly fallback (Option B2 baiting / Option A de-novo)
score_assembly()
Score GetOrganelle candidate paths from real assembly output
score_candidates()
Score and rank candidate paths, auto-selecting the best
score_one()
Score one sample's candidate paths and write path_scores (+ auto_select)
score_project()
Score assembled candidate paths for a project and write `path_scores`
stitch_one()
Stitch one sample's selected path; write the `stitched` table + return fasta
stitch_scaffolds()
Order + orient a path's scaffolds along a reference and stitch them
write_blast_ref()
Store one fetched NCBI reference (sequence + features) in the project DB
write_coverage()
Write per-position read depth for one sample's stitched sequence
write_path_scores()
Write scored candidate paths for a sample into the `path_scores` table
